learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn how to join words together like a puzzle to make a perfect sentence!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A sentence is a group of words that are joined together to make complete sense. It tells us a clear message.
A good sentence always starts with a BIG capital letter. It always ends with a special dot called a full stop.

fun_activity.title: 🧩 Word Puzzle
fun_activity.instructions: Write the words Boy A Is He on paper chits. Arrange them to make the correct sentence He is a boy!

quick_recap: ⭐ A sentence is a group of words with a clear meaning.
⭐ Every sentence must start with a capital letter.
⭐ Every telling sentence ends with a full stop.
